title: [GMCP 203.039.M] Mastery: Server supervision and lifecycle orchestration
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-039-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: A durable supervisor starts servers in dependency order, health-checks readiness and liveness, applies bounded restart/backoff/quarantine, drains and reloads without losing admitted work, propagates cancellation, reaps process trees and exposes exact state/reason. Boot storms, crash loops, hangs, upgrades, resource exhaustion and host restart converge automatically without duplicate instances or silent capability loss. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
